purpose: Frozen observed-state local planned paths, not online robot navigation
scenario_source: Pinned Robot_run.py, original two diagnostic runs; all decisions retained
eligibility_rule: Nonempty original skeleton path with more than two vertices; excludes immediate two-vertex moves that do not invoke bundle optimization

collision_convention.primary: Point-robot obstacle-interior excluding; obstacle-boundary contact permitted
collision_convention.radius_0_5: Clearance diagnostic only, not a comparable finite-radius experiment
collision_convention.world_boundary: No global planner bound; links must be covered by the union of recorded local sights

our_graph_rule: Current continuous adapter's scan-center vertices plus identical start/target; undirected Euclidean link iff its whole segment is certified by frozen sight union
source_graph_rule: Original source skeleton graph and skeleton path are frozen as context; original ASP is recovered unchanged

timing.source: Authors' Python 3.14.2 implementation; separately measure ASP core and wall call
timing.ours: C++ visibility_search in Python 3.12.10 binding; separately measure edge certification/build and core call
timing.caveat: Different language runtimes and graph representations; timing is descriptive, not an algorithm-only speedup

selection_policy: Every eligible snapshot; include all failures and strict-invalid paths in output
